notes.title: More & Improved Answers
notes.notes:
Hey all!

This is just a quick update, but we've done additional improvements with her dialogue, so she should give better answers.

We also just want to say thanks to everyone giving us feedback!

The number one feedback we are getting is "I don't know what to do or ask".

We are planing to create a detective board to help players map things out, so they know what they should question and why, however this is in the future.

We actually want to experiment to create a 3D version of this game, to see if it becomes more immersive, so that is next on our list!

But keep giving us feedback, it does help us improve the game concept!

notes.title: The game now has YouTube safe music!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We know how annoying this is for gaming content creators, so we are we are happy to say that the game now has a custom made music soundtrack!

Meaning you can play the game (or upload a video play-through) on any platform without the fear of being Copyright claimed or muted! Yay!

notes.title: More & Improved Answers
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We just wanted to say that we have done some updates to the game!

- We've improved and additional answers to the game!
- We've also added more achievements
- Lastly, as you might have noticed, we have changed the game's logotype and art-work outside the game!

As always, we also would like to thank everyone who continuously gives us feedback!

We appreciate all the feedback we are getting on all our channels (from in-game to DMs) in order to improve the game! Thank you!

notes.title: Introducing achievements
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We've been experimenting with adding some kind of an achievement system into the game, because we think it would be fun to reward players asking certain questions!

However, since the detailed story plot is such an important part of the core, we don't want to create a system that would somehow reveal or spoil the story.

So we've decided to create a set of achievements, but let them remain hidden until they are achieved.

We would love to get feedback on this system and if it is good or bad and how it can be improved going forward!
